headline: Hikal's Bengaluru API facility receives SwissMedic GMP certification
hook: Swiss regulatory approval clears export path
summary: Hikal Limited announced that its Bengaluru active pharmaceutical ingredient facility has successfully earned the SwissMedic GMP certification. This regulatory clearance validates the plant's manufacturing standards against stringent Swiss pharmaceutical requirements. The approval enhances the company's credibility and facilitates smoother export operations into regulated European markets. Indian retail investors should note this quality validation as a positive development for Hikal's export-driven revenue pipeline.
why_it_matters: Higher export potential to European markets for Hikal
